question: Is the 29 January 2018 cloud computing circular still current?
gold_answer: Not as issued. Deadline moved to 31-03-2020 (19-06-2019); data archival and review rules added (05-07-2019); cloud empanelment ended 30-04-2021 and buying moved to GeM (23-04-2021). Latest: 23-04-2021
model_answer: No, the 29 January 2018 cloud computing circular is not still current. The 23 April 2021 GR supersedes the earlier empanelment and directs all departments to procure cloud services through the GeM portal, with the previous empanelment rates ending on 30 April 2021. Earlier, the 29 January 2018 circular required migration to cloud by 30 October 2018 and set out the initial operational instructions.
